title: UmageAI.Optimizely.GraphSearchTools appsettings schema
description: Validates the UmageAI:GraphSearchTools and Optimizely:ContentGraph sections of an Optimizely host's appsettings.json. Reference from appsettings.json with a $schema property; other sections (Logging, Kestrel, etc.) are unconstrained.

graphSearchToolsOptions.description: Top-level options bound from the UmageAI:GraphSearchTools configuration section.

AuthorizedRoles.description: Role names allowed to access the addon's CMS shell tools. Default: ["WebAdmins", "Administrators"].

CheckPermissionForEachFeature.description: When true, each tool additionally checks its corresponding EPiServer PermissionType. When false (default), only the umageai:graphsearchtools policy is enforced.

SearchableContentTypes.description: Content-type names the addon considers searchable when computing pinned/synonym coverage. Default: ["_Page"].

Graph.description: Per-environment override of Optimizely Graph credentials. When omitted (or any property is null), the addon falls back to the host's Optimizely:ContentGraph block.

featureToggles.description: Boolean toggles for each tool. Disabling a feature hides its menu entry and gates its endpoints. All default to true.

Telemetry.description: When false, the ingest endpoint returns 404 and no telemetry pipeline is wired.

graphConnectionOptions.description: Optimizely Graph connection credentials. Mirrors the host's Optimizely:ContentGraph block; partial overrides are valid — any null property falls back to the host value.

GatewayAddress.description: Base URL of the Optimizely Graph gateway, e.g. https://cg.optimizely.com.

AppKey.description: Application key for HMAC-authenticated Graph calls (admin operations).

Secret.description: Application secret paired with AppKey for HMAC auth.

SingleKey.description: Single-key credential for read-only Graph queries (Try-it panel, search-coverage audit).

DefaultQuery.description: Default GraphQL document the Saved-Queries tool pre-loads.

DefaultQueryVariables.description: Default variables for the DefaultQuery document.

localTelemetryOptions.description: Local telemetry sink/reader tuning. See LocalTelemetryOptions.cs for full semantics.

QueueCapacity.description: Max in-memory channel depth before DropOldest engages. Default: 65536.

FlushInterval.description: Flush cadence for the BucketFlusher hosted service. TimeSpan format (e.g. "00:01:00"). Default: 60s.

RawRingCapacity.description: Per-instance raw-event forensic ring size. Default: 10000.

RawRingTtl.description: TTL for raw-event ring entries. Default: 1 hour.

BucketRetention.description: How long aggregated minute-buckets are kept in DDS. Default: 90 days.

NodeId.description: Instance identifier stamped on aggregates. Default: Environment.MachineName.

MaxBodyBytes.description: Max body size for ingest endpoint POST. Capped at 65536. Default: 4096.

MaxPhraseLength.description: Phrases longer than this are truncated. Default: 256.

PerIpEventsPerSecond.description: Per-IP rate limit for the ingest endpoint. Default: 20.

GlobalEventsPerSecond.description: Global rate limit for the ingest endpoint. Default: 2000.

MaxOpenBuckets.description: Max distinct (phrase, channel, locale) buckets the flusher tracks at once. Default: 10000.
